llm_response:
I'll analyze this GitHub issue about a cron job problem with goaccess.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a cron job not working properly when running goaccess, while the same command works fine when executed manually via SSH. This is a classic environment/path issue in cron jobs. The problem is that cron runs with a limited environment and doesn't have the same PATH variable as the user's shell. The solution would be to either use absolute paths in the cron job or set the PATH variable in the crontab. This is a common system administration issue that can be verified through conceptual understanding without needing to build or run any code. The solution can be validated by analyzing the issue description and applying standard knowledge about how cron jobs work compared to interactive shell sessions. No build environment is necessary to verify that providing full paths or setting the PATH variable in crontab would resolve this issue.
